column3: Near-verbatim objection: death, dust, and bones are treated as incompatible with later accountability.
Guidance from darkness to light does not clarify bodily emergence after death.

Repeats the precise claim that death, dust, and bones preclude being raised.

Near-verbatim formulation of the objection to resurrection from dust and bones.
